title: 星尘航标
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: high-end 3D fantasy exploration game concept screenshot, a single cohesive landscape image, 16:9.
Primary design requirement: all written language must physically belong to the environment. Absolutely NO text boxes, NO panels, NO plaques, NO UI cards, NO speech bubbles, NO bordered labels, NO rectangular glass holograms, NO parchment sheets, NO HUD, NO caption overlays or watermarks. Text glyphs themselves have a physical light/material presence. Render the specified simplified Chinese accurately, with elegant, legible forms, no invented additional lettering.
Art direction: exquisite detailed materials, believable cinematic lighting and shadows, curved organic architecture, warm brass and wood, pearl stone, violet vegetation, blue-green luminous water, magical but restrained sophistication. This is the same cohesive mirror-sea island fantasy world across the series. Depict motion through delicate trails and water ripples, preserve readable formed text. No people.
Scene: wide eye-level view of a magical wooden rooftop observatory at twilight. A magnificent twisting tree on the left hung with tiny glass star lanterns, layered ferns and violet flowers around a curved built-in timber bench, a crescent pond. Left rear cozy timber pergola with jewel-colored cocktail bottles. Center-right a spectacular large organic golden vine-ring portal opens into a vivid swirling spiral galaxy, violet-blue arms and warm core, enough architectural detail to feel physically built. Far right a warm home door in a stone-and-wood arch, a brass telescope. Beyond railings, pearl islands and cloud waterfalls over a luminous teal sea beneath an indigo sky.
Main subject: text as a navigation phenomenon, truly IN the 3D space. Just in front of the galaxy entrance the exact Chinese "进入星系" is formed from warm pearl-gold stardust, modest architectural scale, tack-sharp central glyphs with a few gathering particles on the last stroke, no surface behind it. A thin curving stream of firefly-like light runs low across the timber floor toward this entrance. Above the distant home doorway smaller warm light strokes spell exactly "回家", directly integrated with the door's ambient light. No other text.
Composition: strong depth, portal visible, text large enough to read yet integrated at the portal, neither giant screen-wide title nor pasted graphic. Reflect the text faintly in brass and pond water. Keep the sky and walking route clear. Luxurious game environment with subtle interactive cues, realistic 3D geometry, refined restrained bloom.

Scene: a quiet reading inlet of the sunset canal world, spacious curved pearl stone promenade, a dark mirror pool at center, violet willow-like flowering trees at sides, low amber lanterns, a curved linen bench, distant warm architectural arches and pearly islands dissolving in indigo mist. Camera placed as a reader seated on the bank, calm eye-level view. This is a LONG-FORM READING concept: typography occupies meaningful visual space and is genuinely readable, not decorative words hidden in a vista.
Main subject: an open-air reading arrangement with no surface whatsoever behind it. Pearl-white Chinese letterforms hang quietly over the dark pool around eye level. Exact first paragraph:
"照片留下一个瞬间，文字让它继续生长。
试着写下画面之外的声音、气味和等待。
当这些细节汇合，风景便有了自己的故事。"
Exact second paragraph, slightly farther back but still readable:
"同一条街道，可以有许多种讲述。
你选择靠近谁，又让什么留在远处？
从一个细节出发，写下属于你的答案。"
Below the paragraphs two small isolated standalone words "收藏" and "继续" glow softly; no buttons, borders, icons or underlining enclosures. A few tiny light particles drift at the distant right edge, suggesting a next-paragraph transition, while ALL active text stays crisp. The lake, subtle shadows, and distant mist are organically visible through every gap between the glyphs, no plane, card, rectangle, glass sheet, scroll, book, paper, projector screen, or invisible panel with bounded shading.
Composition: text is the primary focal point, placed over a naturally dark calm area, large enough for comfortable reading in this screenshot; environment frames it softly around the edges, not a graphic frame. Retain exquisite 3D environment detail at corners. No giant title pasted on top of image, everything belongs to scene depth. No poem line effects or excessive text scattering.
